newsitem.title: UK: Virgin complains to European Commission over cola market.
newsitem.headline: Virgin complains to European Commission over cola market.

text.p: Virgin Cola launched a formal complaint with the European Commission on Thursday about what it sees as Coca-Cola Schweppes & Beverages' (CCSB) abuse of its dominant position in Britain's cola market.
Virgin Cola, part of the Virgin Group run by millionaire entrepreneur Richard Branson, wants an investigation into CCSB's "anti-competitive practices," said a spokeswoman at Virgin Cola.

CCSB is currently the subject of a Commission probe into the proposed 700 million pounds ($1.18 billion) sale by Cadbury-Schweppes of its 51 percent stake in the venture to Coca-Cola Enterprises, with the findings due in January.

Virgin Cola claims Coca-Cola uses schemes which offer rebates as an incentive to shops who reach certain sales targets, thereby leaving shopkeepers less inclined to stock competing brands like Virgin or Pepsi.

Discounts are also allegedly offered if a retailer will only stock Coca-Cola drinks. Virgin also claims that other types of drink such as mineral waters may also be tied into such schemes, blocking sales not only of cola drinks.
Cadbury-Schweppes was quick to refute the claims.

"We would point out that these allegations seem to ignore the findings of the UK Monoplies and Mergers Commission (MMC) inquiry in 1991 into the UK carbonated soft drinks market," said a spokeswoman at Cadbury-Schweppes.

The MMC made no adverse findings about the home trade after a year long investigation and CCSB changed its "practices regarding range discounts and exclusive agreements in on premise trade following the MMC recommendations," she said.
"The European Commission was closely consulted when the MMC undertook this inquiry," she added.

"We believe that the beverages market in the UK is very competitive and will continue to be very competitive after this deal goes through. We are continuing to co-operate with the commission in its inquiry and remain confident that the proposed sale of CCSB will be completed in Janaruy."

Virgin is currently ranked number three in terms of cola sales in Britain behind Coca-Cola and Pepsi. CCSB adds water to concentrate, carbonates and bottles and distributes a range of soft drinks. ($1=.5940 Pound)
